8: AG-UI is the runtime-to-application event boundary. UAR emits authoritative run
9: events; clients maintain projections.
10: 
11: ## Envelope
12: 
13: Require protocol version, event ID, run ID, sequence, timestamp, event type,
14: typed payload, and optional causal parent. Event IDs are stable across retries.
15: 
16: ## Semantics
17: 
18: - Apply events idempotently and in sequence.
19: - Resume streams with the last committed event ID.
20: - Represent approval, denial, cancellation, timeout, and failure explicitly.
21: - Keep tool inputs and outputs redacted according to policy.
22: - Preserve unknown event types without treating them as success.
23: - Never infer completion from prose.
24: 
25: Test disconnect/reconnect, duplicate and out-of-order events, restart recovery,
26: slow consumers, cancellation races, unknown versions, and projection replay.
